description: No Windows drive letter required for correctness. All T:/ defaults have portable fallbacks active when the drive is absent. Paths override-able via env vars. Tests run against temp dirs.
invariants: No T:/ or any other drive letter is required for determinex_settings to import
Paths with no local fallback (swebench_repos, programbench_dir, pb_tasks_root) remain as-is — these tools require external data and document that requirement
All path defaults overrideable by env var regardless of drive letter presence
Tests inject paths via env vars into temp dirs — no T:/ access required to run test suite

drive_letter_audit.no_fallback_reason: These require external benchmark data; absence is expected on dev machines without benchmarks installed
